purpose: Creative user-question catalog and candidate human-evaluation scenarios; not an executed benchmark.
provenance: Authored suggestions. YT-001–YT-020 target the source interval from a successful integration run, but these exact prompts have not been executed or independently scored.
evaluation_status: All 100 untested; expected_response_behavior is a qualitative review criterion, not a factual golden answer.
usage: Set Start, End and Spoiler cutoff explicitly. Replace placeholders. Other-source questions need footage containing the relevant content; no source coverage is guaranteed.
